messages.name: (mouse)
messages.digest: Click to choose monitor/output display modes
messages.description: Clicking on the triangular area at the left side ofwill toggle between Signal Monitor display mode (green waveform) and Signal Output display mode (yellow or green downward arrow). When in Signal Output display mode, clicking in the area that displays the number changes the value of the signal sent out the left outlet ofand/or selects it for typing.

messages.name: allow
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets what display modes can be used.restrictsto signal output display mode.restrictsto input monitor display mode.allows both modes, and lets the user switch between them by clicking on the left triangular area of.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: In signal output mode, amessage will output the current signal value.

messages.name: flags
messages.description: Themessage is provided for legacy support of theobject; all the original functionality is now provided by object attributes.

messages.name: float
messages.description: In left inlet: The value is sent out the left outlet as a constant signal. Whenis in Signal Output display mode, the value is displayed. If the current ramp time is non-zero, the output signal will ramp between its previous value and the newly set value.In right inlet: Sets a ramp time in milliseconds. The default time is 0.

messages.name: ft1
messages.description: In right inlet: Sets a ramp time in milliseconds. The default time is 0.

messages.name: int
messages.description: Converted to.In left inlet: The value is sent out the left outlet as a constant signal. Whenis in Signal Output display mode, the value is displayed. If the current ramp time is non-zero, the output signal will ramp between its previous value and the newly set value.In right inlet: Sets a ramp time in milliseconds. The default time is 0.

messages.name: list
messages.digest: Set a signal value and ramp time
messages.description: The first number sets the value of the signal sent out the left outlet, and the second number sets the ramp time in milliseconds.

messages.name: max
messages.description: The word, followed by an optional number, sets the maximum value offor signal output. Note that unlike a floating-point number box, the maximum value ofis not restricted to being an integer value. If the wordis not followed by a number, any maximum value is removed.

messages.name: min
messages.description: The word, followed by an optional number, sets the minimum value offor signal output. Note that unlike a floating-point number box, the minimum value ofis not restricted to being an integer value. If the wordis not followed by a number, any minimum value is removed.

messages.name: mode
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the current display mode, if it is currently allowed (see themessage).sets signal output display mode.sets signal input monitor display mode.

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Display a number without causing output
messages.description: The wordfollowed by a number sets theobject to display that number without causing output.

messages.name: signal
messages.digest: Signal input to be sampled and output
messages.description: Any signal, the value of which is sampled and sent out the right outlet at regular intervals. Whenis in Signal Monitor display mode, the signal value is displayed.
